bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM 7 PM PST THIS EVENING THROUGH 7 AM SATURDAY... Combined seas 7 to 9 ft building to 10 to 13 ft tonight. Bar conditions moderate becoming rough tonight. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 100 AM Thursday, 130 PM Thursday, and 200 AM Friday.
